carryon_allowance.value: 1 piece of hand baggage of 8 kg, format 55cm x 40cm x 23cm.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: These allowances apply on People's Altenrhein–Vienna route; holiday destinations from Altenrhein have their own rules.

allowance_regular.value: Altenrhein/Vienna, regular fare: 20 kg free baggage per person, including children from 2 years; babies 0–2 have no free baggage.

allowance_premium.value: Altenrhein/Vienna, Premium fare (Flex or ticket block): 30 kg free baggage per person, including children from 2 years; babies 0–2 have no free baggage.

excess_fee.value: Exceeding the allowance costs EUR/CHF 50.- for a further 20 kg. Maximum weight per piece is 32 kg. Babies and children may also bring a pram or buggy free.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
